page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the end of most lines, so line endings are missing. The Hebrew word in the middle of the third-last paragraph is only partly visible and may be misread: [?] should be read as uncertain. The "pro" at the bottom right is treated as a catchword. The "III." opening the paragraph is a numeral, so it is a paragraph, not a heading.
